name: alibaba_1688_open-mcp
display_name: 1688 (Alibaba China wholesale) — 一件代发 / 跨境专供 + 1688 Open Platform MCP
description: 1688 (Alibaba China wholesale) — 一件代发 / 跨境专供 + 1688 Open Platform (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_pr

platform_mcp_alibaba_1688_open_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_1688_OPEN_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_alibaba_1688_open_client_id.description: appKey of your 1688 Open Platform app (it is also the last URL path segment of every call).

platform_mcp_alibaba_1688_open_client_se.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_1688_OPEN_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_alibaba_1688_open_client_se.description: appSecret of the same app; signs every call (_aop_signature = uppercase hex HMAC-SHA1 over the urlPath from 'param2' + sorted name+value, https://open.1688.com/doc/signature.htm) and refreshes tokens.

platform_mcp_alibaba_1688_open_refresh_t.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_1688_OPEN_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_alibaba_1688_open_refresh_t.description: refresh_token from the OAuth getToken exchange (need_refresh_token=true, https://open.1688.com/doc/apiAuth.htm); valid for the service subscription period (up to half a year). Access tokens (10 hours) are minted from it.

platform_mcp_alibaba_1688_open_language.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_1688_OPEN_LANGUAGE
platform_mcp_alibaba_1688_open_language.description: Language of translated titles for search and product detail (country: en, ja, ko, es, …; see the API's developer reference).

platform_mcp_alibaba_1688_open_order_flo.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_1688_OPEN_ORDER_FLOW
platform_mcp_alibaba_1688_open_order_flo.description: fastCreateOrder flow: general (wholesale order), saleproxy / fenxiao (一件代发 dropshipping order; the seller must have authorised proxy sales), boutiquefenxiao, …

tools.name: me
tools.description: system/currentTime (the signing example API): verifies the appKey, signature and that an access token can be minted from the refresh token.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: 多语言关键词搜索 (cross-border keyword search): `query` is required and may be in the configured language (keywordTranslate); prices are CNY strings (price = wholesale, dropship_price = consignPrice for 一件代发). `id` is the offerId for get_product.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: 多语言商品详情: translated title, images, attributes, productSkuInfos[{skuId, specId, price, consignPrice, amountOnSale, skuAttributes}], productSaleInfo (price ranges, 一件代发 fenxiaoSaleInfo) and shipping info. `sku` is the FIRST SKU's specId, which create_order's items take.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: 快速创建订单 (fastCreateOrder) with the configured flow. `items` are cargoParamList [{offerId, specId, quantity}] and `shipping_address` is 1688's addressParam {fullName, mobile, phone, postCode, provinceText, cityText, areaText, townText, address} with Chinese region names (a mainland China / consolidation-warehouse address). The order is unpaid (支付宝担保交易 by default); outOrderId is a fresh UUID for idempotency.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: 订单详情 (buyer view): status (waitbuyerpay, waitsellersend, waitbuyerreceive, success, cancel, …), totalAmount in CNY, createTime like '20170913231708000-0700'; products, nativeLogistics and invoice in raw.result.

tools.name: track
tools.description: 物流跟踪 (buyer view): one row per logistics order with the waybill number (logisticsBillNo) and logisticsSteps[{acceptTime, remark}] in time order (Chinese carrier scans).
